svg.aria-label: For z = 0, 0.5, 1 and 1.5, the length of the force (z + sin q, cos q - 1) as a function of q from 0 to pi, solid, and its majorant (2 + z^2/4) sin(q/2) + z cos(q/2), dashed in the same colour just above it; for z = 0 the two coincide, as the chord 2 sin(q/2)
